mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.nickname, u.role, u.created_at AS createdAt, COUNT(e.expense_id) AS expenseCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.transaction_type = 'EXPENSE' AND e.is_settlement = false THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalExpenseAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.transaction_type = 'INCOME' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalIncomeAmount FROM users u LEFT JOIN expenses e ON e.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.role, u.created_at ORDER BY u.created_at DESC
